cards.card_text: True or false: He made intercession for them.
cards.verse_text: Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
cards.snippet: Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors.

cards.card_text: He urges that petitions, prayers, intercessions and thanksgiving be offered.
cards.verse_text: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone—
